fields.name: Provider name
fields.presetTypePlaceholder: Pick a provider type to auto-fill the API URL (optional)
fields.presetTypeHint: Only the API base URL is filled in. Enter the models yourself.
fields.modelsHint: Fetch models from the provider and check the ones to enable, or type a model ID to add it manually. Disabled models are hidden from character setup.
fields.modelsEmptyHint: No models yet: click Fetch models or type a model ID
fields.modelsPlaceholder: Search or type a model ID, then press Enter
fields.secretBuiltinHint: Built-in presets can store a key here without changing URL or model list.
fields.secretPlaceholderConfigured: Leave empty to keep the existing key
fields.paramsHint: Optional. Used as defaults for every model call through this provider (per-member settings can override). Leave empty to omit the parameter and let the server use its default.
fields.temperatureHint: Controls randomness: lower is more deterministic, higher is more diverse. Models such as K3 / K3.1-pro ignore this parameter.
fields.topPHint: Samples from candidates whose cumulative probability reaches this value. Usually tuned instead of temperature.
fields.topKHint: Samples only from the K most likely tokens. Not supported by every provider.
fields.maxTokensHint: Maximum tokens per reply. Leave empty to use the provider default.
fields.frequencyPenaltyHint: Positive values reduce repetition of tokens already used. Range -2 to 2.
fields.presencePenaltyHint: Positive values encourage the model to introduce new topics. Range -2 to 2.
fields.customParamsHint: Advanced: pass other vendor-specific parameters as a JSON object, e.g. {"repetition_penalty": 1.1}. Merged with the fields above.
